versions.content: In the state ETHSM_STATE_OFFLINE the state machine shall have a transition to ETHSM_STATE_WAIT_TRCVLINK, if the ComM requests COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION for the corresponding network handle. In this transition the EthSM shall interact like specified in the sequence diagram Figure 9-1.
